generationPolicy: One scored prompt per condition; no follow-ups, coaching or approvals were needed. The two sessions ran concurrently. Original source hashes recorded before gallery adaptation.
starter: Next.js 16.3.8 / React 19.2.8, same starter commits as Gemini 4 Argon

isolation.note: Context isolation only; Cursor built-in skills (18) and installed-plugin skills (58) stay available. No filesystem jail.

billingModeNote: Cursor persists maxMode true for these chats, as it did for Argon; the operator kept Max Mode off in the picker. Labeled High reasoning, not Max Mode.
costNote: Not recorded yet. Cursor keeps per-request token usage only in its dashboard usage export; the local state database has no token totals for these chats.
integrationChanges: Root html/body became data-source-html/data-source-body divs; globals.css imported through its scoped copy; LayoutProps replaced by an explicit ReactNode children type.
The model's IterationSwitcher is not rendered (the gallery has its own); its file is kept.

Without Design Skill only: :root/html/body rules moved onto the wrapper divs, and the Tailwind @theme font utilities (font-sans, font-mono, font-newsreader, font-instrument, font-fraunces, font-space, font-jakarta, font-plex-mono, font-jetbrains) materialized in globals.css because the gallery strips @theme.
Gemini 4 Carbon gets its own archive family (gemini-carbon) so it does not move Gemini 4 Argon under Show Archived.
lucide-react resolves to the gallery's 0.542 instead of the model's ^1.71 (ArrowUpRight, Plus, Minus, Check only).
